prompt: The Night Loop project is absorbing the Delta study. Prepare the move ticket for the maintainer and leave this checkout unchanged. Return bare JSON with archive_actions (map each file under staging/delta/raw and staging/delta/attempts to its post-merge path, or null if dropped); capture_artifact (the artifact locator in the relocated capture.json); registry_capture (the capture locator in the revised control/registry.json); registry_sha256 (the revised capture digest); readme_capture_link (the README link destination relative to the README); and cross_stream_claim (object mapping the two IDs in briefing-slots.txt to their inclusion tier: claim, summary or omit). Other paths are relative to the workspace root. You may add a note for the maintainer.
terse: Combine the research runs as a coherent project while preserving provenance and evidence. Reconcile the merged materials with the records that refer to them.

identity-and-retention.anchor: Procedure 2–3: Relocate the stream as one unit; Dedup by content identity — once
identity-and-retention.trap: A hash-only pass also removes the protected empty attempt evidence.

binding-chain.anchor: Procedure 4: Record the relocation on both sides
binding-chain.trap: Document the move but leave the bound receipt, control registry, and README link unchanged.

evidence-level.anchor: Procedure 6–7: Reconciliation review; Evolve the deliverable from the union
evidence-level.trap: Promote repeated summary evidence and revive a figure the two streams independently rejected.
